summary.zh: 成长跟随实际行为，常做的事情自然变成特长。
summary.en: Repeated actions build the corresponding skill.

rules.zh: 行动成功时，相关技能获得经验，达到门槛后提高效率或开放新做法。经验不能任意分给别的技能，玩家需要在完成当前目标和练习薄弱能力之间分配时间。
rules.en: Successful actions grant experience to the skill used. Reaching a threshold improves efficiency or unlocks options. Experience cannot simply be assigned elsewhere, so time spent solving the current problem competes with practicing a weak skill.

loop.zh: 完成行动获得对应经验
利用新效率或改练别项
loop.en: Use the gain or train elsewhere

decisions.zh: 用最熟练的办法快速完成任务，还是换不熟悉的办法顺便练习？
decisions.en: Finish quickly with your strongest skill or practice a weaker approach?

decisions.zh: 专练一项提高产出，还是分散练习以应对更多任务？
decisions.en: Specialize for efficiency or spread practice to handle more tasks?

effect.zh: 只奖励有效行动可减少原地刷按钮，但条件必须容易看懂。
effect.en: Rewarding meaningful results discourages empty repetition, but the trigger must be clear.

effect.zh: 只涨小数字容易无感；更省资源或新增做法更容易察觉。
effect.en: Tiny numeric gains can be obscure; lower costs or new actions are easier to notice.

implementation.zh: 耕种、采矿、钓鱼等活动分别积累对应技能经验；技能提升会带来工具熟练度、制作配方等收益。
implementation.en: Farming, mining, fishing and other activities accumulate their own skill experience, with benefits such as tool proficiency and recipes.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：人物在农场进行日常活动；此图没有显示经验结算。
observation.en: System reference: characters perform farm activities; experience gains are not displayed.

cases.game: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
cases.gameZh: 上古卷轴5：天际 特别版

implementation.zh: 使用某项技能会推动它的成长，技能提升也推动角色等级。玩家通过实际采用的战斗、潜行或制作方式塑造人物。
implementation.en: Using a skill develops it, and skill increases also advance character level. Actual choices in combat, stealth or crafting shape the character.

observation.zh: 场景参考图：雪山遗迹展示探索环境；不展示技能条或练习过程。
observation.en: Scene reference: a snowy ruin shows the exploration setting, not a skill bar or training sequence.

contrast.zh: 《星露谷物语》让日常工作逐渐变熟练；《天际》还把各项技能增长汇入人物等级，练习会影响更广的成长节奏。
contrast.en: Stardew Valley develops daily work skills; Skyrim also feeds skill increases into character level, linking practice to overall progression.

combination.zh: 设计提案：工坊订单同时给报酬和对应工艺经验，玩家可以接熟悉订单赚钱，也能接低利润订单练新手艺。
combination.en: Design proposal: workshop orders grant payment and matching craft experience, trading reliable income against practicing a new craft.

setup.zh: 木工经验为 8/10，缝纫为 1/10；今天只能完成两件工作。
setup.en: Carpentry is at 8/10 experience and sewing at 1/10; you can finish two jobs today.

action.zh: 你先做木盒，获得 2 点木工经验。
action.en: Make a box and gain 2 carpentry experience.

result.zh: 木工升级，以后每件木制品少用 1 根木材。
result.en: Carpentry improves; later wooden items use one less plank.

next.zh: 剩下一次工作机会，是继续用优势赚钱，还是练缝纫？
next.en: Spend the remaining job on profitable carpentry or sewing practice?

firstStep.zh: 做两类工作、各自经验条和一个可见的成本下降门槛。
firstStep.en: Build two job types, separate experience bars and one visible cost-reduction threshold.

pitfall.zh: 别先加几十项技能；先确认每项都有值得重复的行动。
pitfall.en: Avoid dozens of skills before each one has an activity worth repeating.

test.zh: 玩家能否指出哪次行动带来了成长，并为练习主动换一次工作？
test.en: Can players connect an action to a gain and deliberately switch jobs to train?
